caption: POV: eating at the best ramen spot in Tokyo 🍜 @ramen_nakamura

transcript.text: We're at Nakamura Ramen in Shinjuku and oh my god.
Look at this tonkotsu broth, it's been cooking for 18 hours.
The noodles are house made, you can see them pulling them fresh.
These chashu pork slices are absolutely insane.
Twelve dollars for this bowl, can you believe it?
I've had ramen all over Tokyo and this is easily top three.
